from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np, itertools

tmpl = "[C{c}H](c1ccc2ccccc2c1)(c1ccccc1)[Ni]1([C-]2N(c3c(C)cc(C)cc3C)CCN2c2c(C)cc(C)cc2C)[OH+][B{b}-]2(c3ccc(OC)cc3)OCC(C)(C)C[O+]12"

def analyze(mol, conf):
    pos = conf.GetPositions()
    ri = mol.GetRingInfo()
    # find Ni
    Ni = [a.GetIdx() for a in mol.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=="Ni"][0]
    B  = [a.GetIdx() for a in mol.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=="B"][0]
    # benzylic carbon: sp3 C bonded to Ni
    bz = None
    for nb in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(Ni).GetNeighbors():
        if nb.GetSymbol()=="C" and nb.GetTotalNumHs(includeNeighbors=True)==1 and not nb.GetIsAromatic():
            # must have two aromatic C neighbors
            ar = [x for x in nb.GetNeighbors() if x.GetIsAromatic()]
            if len(ar)==2: bz=nb.GetIdx()
    a = mol.GetAtomWithIdx(bz)
    H = [x.GetIdx() for x in a.GetNeighbors() if x.GetSymbol()=="H"][0]
    ars = [x.GetIdx() for x in a.GetNeighbors() if x.GetIsAromatic()]
    nap = [i for i in ars if ri.NumAtomRings(i)==2 or any(ri.NumAtomRings(j)==2 for j in [n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()])]
    # distinguish: naphthyl attached carbon belongs to ring whose atoms include fused atoms
    def is_nap(i):
        # BFS within aromatic system size
        seen={i}; stack=[i]
        while stack:
            k=stack.pop()
            for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(k).GetNeighbors():
                if n.GetIsAromatic() and n.GetIdx() not in seen:
                    seen.add(n.GetIdx()); stack.append(n.GetIdx())
        return len(seen)==10
    napC=[i for i in ars if is_nap(i)][0]
    phC =[i for i in ars if i!=napC][0]
    # boron oxygens
    Os=[x.GetIdx() for x in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(B).GetNeighbors() if x.GetSymbol()=="O"]
    oh=ol=orr=None
    for o in Os:
        nbs=[x.GetSymbol() for x in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(o).GetNeighbors()]
        if "H" in nbs: oh=o
        elif "Ni" in nbs: ol=o
        else: orr=o
    pmpC=[x.GetIdx() for x in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(B).GetNeighbors() if x.GetIsAromatic()][0]
    def det(center, i1,i2,i3,i4):
        c=pos[center]
        v=[pos[i]-c for i in (i1,i2,i3,i4)]
        return float(np.dot(v[0]-v[3], np.cross(v[1]-v[3], v[2]-v[3])))
    d1=det(bz, Ni, napC, phC, H)
    d2=det(B, ol, oh, orr, pmpC)
    return d1,d2,dict(bz=bz,B=B,Ni=Ni)

results={}
for c in ["@","@@"]:
    for b in ["@","@@"]:
        smi=tmpl.format(c=c,b=b)
        m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
        mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
        ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=0xf00d; ps.useRandomCoords=True
        cid=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,ps)
        if cid!=0:
            print(c,b,"embed fail"); continue
        d1,d2,info=analyze(mh,mh.GetConformer())
        print(c,b,"det_C=%.2f (R if <0)"%d1,"det_B=%.2f (R if <0)"%d2)
        results[(c,b)]=(d1,d2,mh)
import pickle
pickle.dump({k:(v[0],v[1]) for k,v in results.items()}, open("res.pkl","wb"))
for k,v in results.items():
    if v[0]<0 and v[1]<0:
        Chem.MolToMolFile(v[2],"chosen.mol")
        print("chosen",k)

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
smi = "[C@H](c1ccc2ccccc2c1)(c1ccccc1)[Ni]1([C-]2N(c3c(C)cc(C)cc3C)CCN2c2c(C)cc(C)cc2C)[OH+][B@@-]2(c3ccc(OC)cc3)OCC(C)(C)C[O+]12"
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=42; ps.useRandomCoords=True; ps.pruneRmsThresh=0.5
cids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(mh,30,ps)
print(len(cids))
res=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(mh,maxIters=2000) if AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(mh) else AllChem.UFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(mh,maxIters=2000)
print(res[:5])
import pickle
# pick lowest energy converged
best=min(range(len(cids)),key=lambda i:res[i][1])
print("best",best,res[best])
Chem.MolToMolFile(mh,"best.mol",confId=cids[best])
Chem.MolToXYZFile(mh,"start.xyz",confId=cids[best])
Ni=[a.GetIdx() for a in mh.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=="Ni"][0]
conf=mh.GetConformer(cids[best]); pos=conf.GetPositions()
for nb in mh.GetAtomWithIdx(Ni).GetNeighbors():
    print(nb.GetSymbol(),nb.GetIdx(),np.linalg.norm(pos[Ni]-pos[nb.GetIdx()]))
print(mh.GetNumAtoms())

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np, pickle
mh=pickle.load(open("ref.pkl","rb"))
ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=7; ps.useRandomCoords=True
cids=list(AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(mh,10,ps))

Ni=[a.GetIdx() for a in mol.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=="Ni"][0]

        for nb in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(k).GetNeighbors():
            if nb.GetIsAromatic() and nb.GetIdx() not in seen: seen.add(nb.GetIdx()); st.append(nb.GetIdx())
